info.name: Rillet Accounting API Key Vendor Credit Applications API
Applies a vendor credit to bills

params.name: vendor_credit_id
params.description: UUID of the vendor credit to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Allocates an existing vendor credit balance against specific open bills, reducing net amounts payable similar to a targeted vendor payment.
Use after reviewing retrieve-a-vendor-credit so you apply only the remaining unapplied balance.
